items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: And we also had Sy Oliver with him, because you know, Sy Oliver was the arranger for that.

ctx.x: Well, here in 1974, who was that now?

Well, in 1974 I toured England, with Warren Covington playing the music with Tommy Dorsey. And we also had Sy Oliver with him, because you know, Sy Oliver was the arranger for that. So the first segment of the show was the things that Tommy did before Sy Oliver started writing for the band, and then the second part, Sy was the conductor, and he did all of these things like ...
